summaries.class_summary: HPXPrinterDetails is an Android test automation page class that extends SmartFlow. It provides comprehensive methods for interacting with HP printer details screen, including navigation to various printer tiles (scan, print, copy, fax, shortcuts), product information retrieval, printer configuration, and report generation. The class implements a common pattern of swipe-and-find for UI elements with configurable retry attempts and timeout handling. It supports both verification and action methods for printer-related features, making it suitable for end-to-end testing of HP Smart mobile app printer functionality.
